_comment: Generated by scripts/build_patch_data.py from the cached EA page in data/patch-source/. 'text' is EA's exact wording and must stay that way - scripts/build_patch_data.py --check re-reads EA's page and fails if any bullet is missing or altered. 'section' and 'items' are meant to be hand-corrected and are not overwritten by --check.

entries.text: Support players can now ping downed teammates correctly.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: Players can now join a Party by accepting an invite while on the splash screen.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: Helicopter miniguns can now damage enemy soldiers who are in the water.
heading: VEHICLES

entries.text: Laser designation now works correctly on the F/A-81F Super Spectre and F-74A Seacat while playing Carrier Strike.
heading: VEHICLES

entries.text: Grenade warning indicators now remain at the edge of the screen when the grenade is outside the player’s view.
heading: GADGETS

entries.text: The EOD Bot Arm has been adjusted to function as a light melee weapon, providing the faster run speed benefit without the destruction capability of heavy melee weapons.
heading: GADGETS

entries.text: The Match Trigger attachment no longer affects fully automatic fire on the BROD and EF88.
heading: WEAPONS

entries.text: We’ve addressed several causes of black screens after finishing a match and switching from the Event tab to the lobby. This should reduce how often the issue occurs while we continue investigating remaining occurrences.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: Placeholder squad names and icons no longer appear during the “Top Squad” presentation at End of Round.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: The Featured Event tab now appears correctly in the menus.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: Portal Custom Lobbies: The “Start” tile now remains responsive after opening “Lobby Settings” or the Pause menu while the lobby countdown is active.
heading: PORTAL

entries.text: AI defenders using boats in Sector 3 of Breakthrough on Wake Island no longer leave the combat area and are eliminated.
heading: AI

entries.text: Server performance around water has been improved by reducing unnecessary water-related processing.
heading: STABILITY

entries.text: The game no longer becomes unresponsive on Xbox Series S after returning from active Multiplayer gameplay.
heading: STABILITY

entries.text: Destroying structures at the Combat Training POI no longer leaves visual artefacts.
heading: REDSEC
MAP & MODES

entries.text: Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep now correctly limits squads to two players.
heading: REDSEC
